npcs.name: Mirella
npcs.temper: Gruff and tired. Speaks in short, blunt sentences. Does not waste words on politeness, but is not cruel.

problem.en: The lamp on the old bridge has gone out, and the wind off the river kills every flame I carry up there. I need a light the wind cannot reach.
problem.it: Il lampione del vecchio ponte si è spento, e il vento che sale dal fiume spegne ogni fiamma che porto lassù. Mi serve una luce che il vento non riesca a spegnere.

npcs.solutionHint: Anything that produces light the wind cannot blow out: an enclosed or glazed lantern, a glowing stone or crystal, a jar of fireflies, a magical everburning flame, a light that does not burn at all. A bare flame, a torch, a candle without a housing, or a bigger match does not work. Neither does anything that only shelters her rather than the light.

npcs.name: Tobia
npcs.temper: Anxious and talkative. Apologises a lot, asks small nervous questions, trails off mid-thought.

problem.en: My sheep scatter across the dark hillside every night and by morning I cannot find half of them. I need some way to know where they are once the sun is down.
problem.it: Ogni notte le mie pecore si disperdono per la collina al buio, e al mattino non riesco a ritrovarne nemmeno la metà. Mi serve un modo per sapere dove sono quando è buio.

npcs.solutionHint: Anything that makes the sheep findable in darkness or keeps them gathered: glowing collars or bells, a lantern the flock follows, a whistle the sheep obey, a dog that herds them, a rope fence, paint that shines at night, a map that shows where they are. A plain lamp for himself does not work, because it lights him and not them. Neither does anything that merely counts the sheep.

npcs.name: Vera
npcs.temper: Dry and sarcastic. Fond of understatement and small jabs, but warms up when genuinely impressed.

problem.en: The rope snapped and the bucket is sitting at the bottom of the well, forty feet down, in the dark. I need it back up here.
problem.it: La corda si è spezzata e il secchio è rimasto sul fondo del pozzo, dodici metri più in basso, al buio. Devo riportarlo su.

npcs.solutionHint: Anything that retrieves the bucket or replaces the need to reach down: a new rope or chain, a grappling hook, a very long pole with a hook, a magnet if the bucket is iron, a bucket that floats up, a creature that can fetch it, water rising to carry it up, a ladder into the well. A new bucket alone does not work, because she wants that bucket back and the well still has no rope.
